decisions.reason: Only a brief website mention and the niche, seasonal citrus crate market make the option's value unlikely to be realized, so we drop it.
A dedicated page and broad applicability of foldable large containers keep the option alive with unresolved upside, so we keep it.
The stackable crate's commodity-like competition and mere website mention indicate a resolved, low-value option, so we drop it.
Medium-duty rackable pallets face strong competition and only a mention, suggesting the option no longer justifies its carrying cost, so we drop it.
Spill-retention pallets benefit from regulatory demand and a dedicated page, so their option value remains high and we keep them.
Plastic pallets with load retainers offer differentiated safety features and have a dedicated page, so the option retains upside and we keep it.
